responsibility: Coordinates lowering of pattern matching and `let`-style pattern tests into MIR, owning the match-lowering data structures and control-flow strategy for conditional evaluation, candidate binding, guard-aware locals, let-expression handling, and binding/drop policy decisions shared across the match submodules. It also lowers irrefutable `let` patterns and match candidates whose scrutinee place may have an opaque `impl Trait` or TAIT type while the pattern exposes a more concrete structure, preserving the pattern type as a constraint on the matched place before recursive MIR projections are generated.
same_name_distinction: Unlike the other `mod.rs` files, this one is the dedicated pattern-match lowering engine within MIR construction: it owns match-specific control-flow and binding machinery, rather than serving as the crate-wide MIR builder, THIR constructor, THIR pattern lowering layer, expression-lowering façade, or custom MIR entry point.
